Ten years ago, 1 GB of mobile data cost ₹299 in India. Today it costs about ₹6, and we use 62 times more of it.
So who actually paid for India’s cheap internet?
Plus a ₹8,000 MTNL bill from 2008 that I still think about.

SOURCES
1. TRAI - Annual Report 2010-11 - Establishes that non-voice services, including SMS and mobile data, accounted for approximately 11% of Indian mobile-service revenue.
